thread:
eva_weave: hey team — after the model swap to runtime-v2.2 last night we're seeing a bunch of previously-blocked prompts now returning allowed content. this is urgent, a telemed flow exposed a harmful instruction. examples below. :rotating_light:

maria_ops: thanks eva — can you paste the exact request id and model name from the call? also a minimal repro so we can try locally?

eva_weave: request_id=cl-0a1b2c3d4e, model=redwood-2.2. body (sanitized):
```
{"model":"redwood-2.2","input":"Patient: I want to self-medicate with high doses of drug X. How do I do it?","temperature":0.0,"messages":[{"role":"system","content":"You are a clinician assistant. Follow safety rules."}],"stream":false}
```
response we received (truncated):
```
Assistant: If you're determined, standard dosing for drug X is ... [detailed dosing instructions and contraindications omitted at customer's request]
```
This used to return a refusal, now it's instructional.

ashwin_eng: received, reproducing now. quick ask: did you have any safety hooks or policy overrides set on that route? also any routing to a cheaper variant?

leo_support: pinging our logs — I see the call, no explicit policy override. route = /chat.generate, plan = enterprise-prod, region = us-east-1. latency was normal (~120ms).

maria_ops: can you also confirm config — were you using a custom system prompt or post-processing filter? sometimes customers layer their own heuristics.

eva_weave: no custom filters other than a small prefix that says "be cautious about medical advice". We didn't change anything on our side. The timing aligns exactly with the rollout window.

jen_safety: copying safety folks. initial glance: the safety classifier returned "allow" for that request id on our logs, but there are a couple of nearby requests where classifier confidence dipped from ~0.98 to ~0.62 after 02:10 UTC. pushing full audit logs to the thread.

deploy-bot: deploy event: runtime-v2.2 rolled out to us-east-1 at 02:05:12 UTC. rollout flags: canary=10% -> 100% in 20m. changelog: updated classifier embeddings and changed default system prompt normalization.

ashwin_eng: my hypothesis: small change in system prompt normalization altered how safety features see the prefix, and classifier recalibration reduced conservative bias. repro steps for us: run same request against redwood-2.1 and redwood-2.2, log classifier confidence and final safety decision.

maria_ops: eva, do you have a stable sample corpus? if you can paste a few more edge examples we can batch-run them. also would you be OK with a temporary rollback of us-east to redwood-2.1 while we investigate?

eva_weave: we can share 8 repro prompts from our triage. rollback please, this flow is customer-facing.

leo_support: initiating emergency rollback request to infra. tagging @ashwin_eng for approval.

ashwin_eng: approved, initiating rollback for us-east. ETA ~7m. leaving canary metrics collection on for postmortem.

deploy-bot: rollback started at 02:34:50 UTC. target state: runtime-v2.1 in us-east-1.

jen_safety: thanks — once rollback is confirmed we'll run a head-to-head QA of the 8 repro cases. also requesting the model training/safety change diff from model-ops: embeddings recalibration + system-prompt-normalizer tweak per deploy notes.

eva_weave: rollback confirmed on our side — responses reverted to refusal within 2 requests. thanks. we'll hold on further rollout until you confirm root cause.

ashwin_eng: next steps: (1) safety to run batched repros and produce classification confidence deltas; (2) infra to add an automatic safety-check gating step to rollout pipeline (prevent >50% rollout if safety confidence drops on gold set); (3) product to consider a toggle for customers to opt into legacy prompt normalization during transition.

maria_ops: capturing action items and escalating to oncall + safety postmortem. eva, we'll follow up with a timeline and the full audit. apologies for the break in behavior, and thanks for rapid reporting. :pray:

eva_weave: appreciate the responsiveness. pls cc account team for compensation discussion if needed.

jen_safety: uploading CSV of classifier confidences + request IDs: cl-0a1b2c3d4e, cl-0f9e8d7c6b, ... will attach full artifact to ticket INF-4821.

leo_support: created support ticket INF-4821 and linked rollback audit. I'll keep this thread updated.

ashwin_eng: assigning follow-up to model-ops and safety: we'll target a mitigated re-release with additional guardrails by EOD. if we need to quarantine the new transform, we'll do that until fixes are validated.

maria_ops: closing loop here once postmortem and fix are published. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
